headings.text: The hidden cost of UUIDs
A transport key is not a reasoning interface.
Keep a literal value when its characters are part of the problem. Otherwise, expose a compact request-scoped handle, validate the symbolic response, and resolve it in trusted software.
Change the tracking load.
One citation score can tell the wrong story.
The effect survives multi-hop retrieval.
The elegant reasoning-budget theory did not replicate.
The production case does not need a speculative theory of hidden reasoning tokens. It rests on measured transport cost, binding reliability, output burden, and exposure reduction.
2,027 tokens. Only 1.2% of the trace correct.
Stable facts. Late surface realization.

The bounded conclusion: semantic source tracking and literal identifier realization are often separable. Similar cross-format geometry does not mean every model family implements the same causal bindi
Typed handles generalize beyond citations.
A useful trust boundary. Not a complete safety proof.
Use the literal only when it matters.
Canonicalize only fields whose spelling is irrelevant.
Keep the reversible map outside model context and ordinary logs.
Bind handles to request and tenant identity.
Validate schema, leakage, membership, type, and action policy.
Rehydrate only accepted outputs.
Re-check authorization, freshness, ranges, and business rules.
Verify consequential targets independently.
Measure answer quality, binding, and formatting separately.
What remains uncertain.
Backend identifiers should not enter model context simply because they are available.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Held-out cells worse with UUIDs" above "10 / 10"; "Input tokens" above "235"; "Latency" above "1.7s"; "Exact binding" above "96%"; "Input tokens" above "386"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 16px at 1440px. Widest offenders: p.mechanism-conclusion.reveal-side (+16px), p (+16px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: 5 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 69% of the width empty: div.section-heading.reveal-up (left 924px empty); div.metric-copy.reveal-up (left 940px empty); div.study-copy.reveal-up (left 995px empty); div.negative-head.reveal-side (left 961px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: 3 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1540px at 11052px; 1264px at 13292px; 2732px at 15316px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (32px, 909px, 995px, 940px, 961px, 205px, 368px); the three most used hold only 58% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 16px from the left edge but only to 36px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
